// diagnostic L0308

Jet.SqlQueryInRowLoop

This query runs once for every row of the loop around it

What

This query runs once for every row of the loop around it

Why

Each pass of the loop makes one more round trip to the database, so N rows cost N + 1 queries, and the loop slows down as the table grows

Fix

Read what the loop needs in one query before it: `WHERE key IN (…)` over the keys the rows hold, or a JOIN with the query that produced the rows

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SqlQueryInRowLoop: Tests/UI/sql_query_in_row_loop.stderr.
